why_best: It gives dense news stories room to breathe by letting viewers digest high-level summaries before opting into granular data.
why_bad: A hard cut or abrupt pop-in would disrupt the viewer's mental map of the editorial hierarchy and feel like a glitch rather than an intentional drill-down.
trap: A clumsy execution will blur the boundary line separating the header from the newly exposed material, making the layout look broken rather than structured.
